AATULYA — FAQ Section
Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before choosing your pathway. Can't find your answer? Reach out — we typically respond within 24 hours.

01Which pathway is right for me?

It depends on where you are today. Future-ready Educator is built for primary & secondary educators getting started with AI and digital tools. Edupreneur Launchpad is for educators, coaches & trainers ready to set up their teaching business. Edupreneur Mastery is for educators ready to grow and monetize. Advanced Edupreneur Mastery is for established educators ready to scale into a full business with 1:1 mentorship.

02Are the sessions live, or can I learn at my own pace?

All four pathways are live, hands-on, and mentor-led. Edupreneur Mastery and Advanced Edupreneur Mastery also include session recordings, so you can revisit any class. Advanced Edupreneur Mastery is delivered through 1:1 coaching rather than a group format.

03Do I need to buy any software or tools?

Most of the tools we teach you to use run on free tiers — that's a core part of how Aatulya is designed. As you move into the growth-stage pathways (Edupreneur Mastery and Advanced Edupreneur Mastery), a few premium tools such as Canva Pro, Meta Ads, and Amazon KDP come into play, which carry their own optional costs outside the program fee.

04How do I enroll and pay?

Click Enroll Now on the pathway you want — it takes you to our secure Razorpay checkout where you can pay by card, UPI, netbanking, or wallet. You'll get a confirmation immediately after payment.

05Can I move to the next pathway later?

Yes. The four pathways are designed as a progression — many educators start with Build or Launch and move into Grow or Master as their teaching business matures. Reach out to our team and we'll help you figure out the right starting point or next step.

06I still have a question — who do I contact?

Call or WhatsApp us at +91 70119 30359, or email hi@aatulya.com. We typically respond within 24 hours.
